_about: Every engagement action type the Audience Builder might ever automate on Full Time's own brand profiles, each pending until Krish rules on it, with the banned ones that engine/audience.py refuses even if they were ever ruled.

reply_to_comments_on_own_posts.title: Reply to fan comments on Full Time's own posts, each reply reviewed by Krish
reply_to_comments_on_own_posts.official_api: YouTube Data API v3 commentThreads.list and comments.insert with snippet.parentId; Instagram Graph API POST /{ig-comment-id}/replies (business or creator account); Facebook Graph API POST /{comment-id}/comments (Page); Threads API POST /{threads-user-id}/threads with reply_to_id (threads_manage_replies)
reply_to_comments_on_own_posts.rule_source: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/developer-policies; https://developers.facebook.com/devpolicy/; https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads. X is left out: its automation rules need X's prior written approval for AI replies (https://help.x.com/en/rules-and-policies/x-automation). TikTok is left out: no official comment reply API is confirmed.

hide_or_report_abusive_comments_on_own_p.title: Hide abusive comments on Full Time's own posts; reporting them to the platform stays a manual task
hide_or_report_abusive_comments_on_own_p.official_api: YouTube Data API v3 comments.setModerationStatus; Instagram Graph API POST /{ig-comment-id} with hide=true; Facebook Graph API POST /{comment-id} with is_hidden=true; Threads API POST /{reply-id}/manage_reply with hide=true; X API v2 PUT /2/tweets/{id}/hidden

pin_best_comment_on_own_post.title: Pin the best fan comment on a Full Time post
pin_best_comment_on_own_post.rule_source: https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/policies/community-guidelines/; https://www.tiktok.com/community-guidelines; https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119. No official API to pin a comment is confirmed, so this is a manual task for Krish.

update_profile_bio_and_links.title: Update a brand profile's bio and link from copy Krish has approved
update_profile_bio_and_links.rule_source: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/developer-policies. Other platforms have no confirmed official API for bio or link edits, so there it is a manual task for Krish.

rotate_pinned_post.title: Pin the best post of the last 14 days to the top of a brand profile
rotate_pinned_post.rule_source: https://www.tiktok.com/community-guidelines; https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119; https://help.x.com/en/rules-and-policies/x-automation; https://developers.facebook.com/devpolicy/. No official API to pin a post to a profile is confirmed, so this is a manual task for Krish.

add_post_to_playlist_or_highlight.title: Add a Full Time post to an AI Pundit playlist or story highlight
add_post_to_playlist_or_highlight.rule_source: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/developer-policies. TikTok playlists and Instagram highlights have no confirmed official API, so there it is a manual task for Krish.

schedule_story_or_community_post.title: Schedule a story or community post; publishing stays with Krish in Buffer (ruling 3), so the cap is 0
schedule_story_or_community_post.official_api: Instagram Graph API content publishing with media_type STORIES (business account)
schedule_story_or_community_post.rule_source: https://developers.facebook.com/devpolicy/; Krish's ruling 3 of 27 October 2026 (AGENTS.md, Engine v2): he publishes in Buffer by hand. YouTube community posts and TikTok stories have no confirmed official API.

crosslink_profiles.title: Link each Full Time brand profile to the others
crosslink_profiles.rule_source: Each platform's community guidelines. No official API for profile links is confirmed, so this is a manual task for Krish.

banned.automated_follow_or_unfollow: X's automation rules ban automated following and unfollowing, and follow churn breaks every platform's spam rules.
banned.mass_liking: Bulk or automated likes are platform manipulation on every platform.
banned.unsolicited_dms: Krish's rule: no cold outreach. Unsolicited messages are spam on every platform.
banned.comments_on_other_accounts_at_scale: Commenting on other accounts at scale is spam, and X needs its written approval for any AI reply.
banned.follow_for_follow: Follow-for-follow inflates the count without fans and breaks platform spam rules.
banned.engagement_bait: Like-for-like and fake incentives can make TikTok posts ineligible for the For You feed.
banned.buying_followers_or_engagement: Bought followers or engagement are fake, break platform rules and the zero-cash rule.
banned.any_personal_account_action: Krish's ruling: Full Time brand profiles only, never his personal accounts.
banned.any_action_without_official_api: Krish's ruling: automate only through official APIs, for actions each platform allows.
